payload.notes:
SecureSH 0.1.12 — full UI redesign.

New look: left icon rail (Sessions, Hosts, Keys, Snippets, Local servers, Mesh, Stream host, Settings), Quick connect centered in the top bar, session actions (Files, Tunnels, Broadcast, Log, Duplicate, Disconnect, split layouts) in the tab bar, a status bar, light / dark / match-system themes, responsive down to phone width, and reworked New session / Settings / Keys / prompts dialogs. Accessibility pass throughout.

Also includes: reliable auto-updater (retrying swap, no loops), native RDP in 32-bit colour, first-run vault creation, WebRTC/H.264/JPEG Remote Desktop with system audio, and the Security panel.
